description: Measured offline-suite line-coverage floor for the packages listed under packages. Floor is measured_percent - epsilon. Do not lower floor_percent without an explicit --allow-lower review; raise it only after a clean offline measurement.
measured_command: python -m pytest -m 'not network and not benchmark' --cov=src --cov=api --cov=data_provider --cov=bot --cov-report=json:coverage.json
notes: PROVISIONAL: floor 0 until first measured offline suite; will be replaced with measured-epsilon after a clean run.
